difficulty: 4 out of 10 (PowerPyx). One playthrough; free roam after the story; no mission replay; no New Game+.

phases.name: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 5

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

phases.text: Finish the five story chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with the binoculars as you travel — that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist. Do the side-character missions when they are offered; quest givers who go quiet mid-story return in free roam.

phases.name: The 100% Completion Checklist

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

phases.text: After the credits, open Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Work the checklist line by line. The checklist is lenient — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion — and the only lines that need everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. You need only 70 of the 80 challenges, so the 10 hardest can be skipped.

phases.name: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

phases.text: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and the side-character final missions, then sweep whatever is left: the miscellaneous trophies, the hidden ones with confirmed methods, and the two that are still unconfirmed. The platinum pops with the last trophy earned.
